slides.texte_overlay:
how to be productive
without burning out

work in short sprints

work for forty five minutes, then take a real ten minute break away from screens. short, focused sprints get more done than a whole day of tired, distracted effort.

rest your mind with something gentle

a few calm minutes of learning something beautiful gives your brain a real break from work stress. a calm, curious pause recharges you far better than another round of scrolling.
slides.texte_sophia:
rest your mind with something gentle

my breaks used to be more scrolling. now i spend 5 minutes on one lesson in the Sophia app, a star or a painting, and i go back to work calm instead of even more drained.

slides.texte_overlay:
choose three tasks

write down only three tasks that truly matter today. a short list is finishable, and finishing it gives you real satisfaction instead of the guilt of a list that never ends.

protect your evenings

pick a time when work stops, and keep it. evenings that belong to you, your people and your hobbies are what give you the energy you need for the next morning.

sleep like it matters

treat sleep as part of your work, not a reward for finishing it. a rested brain does in one hour what a tired one struggles to do in three long, frustrating hours.
